title: AEC official tests the device on himself

tellings.quote: one of the guys is like, "I don't believe you, you know, test me." And just and and and did the test on himself and it worked.

plain: Around 1962, the story goes, an official of the Atomic Energy Commission, the US agency then in charge of nuclear work, doubted a device being shown at Intelectron, a company in New York City. He said "test me," tried it on himself, "and it worked." The researcher Greg Malatzi tells this on the show. He points to letters from the commission and cites the journalist Annie Jacobsen, but does not say what the device did.
